questiontext.text: Why should raw ice NEVER be placed directly onto bare skin during first aid treatment?

generalfeedback.text: Always wrap ice in a clean damp towel to prevent freezing the skin and damaging superficial tissues.

answer.text: It can freeze skin cells and cause tissue frostbite (ice burns)

feedback.text: Correct! Always wrap ice in a clean damp towel to prevent freezing the skin and damaging superficial tissues.
Incorrect. Always wrap ice in a clean damp towel to prevent freezing the skin and damaging superficial tissues.

generalfeedback.text: Elevation uses gravity to reduce hydrostatic pressure, reducing localized swelling and throbbing.

answer.text: Gravity assists excess blood and inflammatory fluids in draining away from the injury

feedback.text: Correct! Elevation uses gravity to reduce hydrostatic pressure, reducing localized swelling and throbbing.
Incorrect. Elevation uses gravity to reduce hydrostatic pressure, reducing localized swelling and throbbing.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Elevation uses gravity to reduce hydrostatic pressure, reducing localized swelling and throbbing.

generalfeedback.text: Bandages, antiseptics, scissors, and gloves are standard first aid supplies. Dumbbells are gym equipment.

generalfeedback.text: Rest and Elevation are parts of R.I.C.E. (along with Ice and Compression).
